summary: Pyxus International filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) revising Item 9.01 and refiling the Transaction Support Agreement dated November 5, 2026, adding a previously omitted Form of Note. The company and subsidiaries Pyxus Parent and Pyxus Holdings entered the TSA with creditor groups holding roughly 74.9% of Pyxus term loans, 67.9% of Intabex term loans, and 56.0% of 8.50% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2027, including Glendon, Owl Creek, Park West and Acasta. No price, premium or close date is stated. Watch execution and participation thresholds.
